rationale: Largest MK chamber; ongoing news, regulatory commentary and payment-operations programming — a durable standalone publisher.
Financial-organisations association page is a section of mchamber.mk; valuable but covered by monitoring the parent domain.
A single 2010 annual-report PDF in the chamber's document store — evidence artefact, not a producing source.
ICT chamber member directory is the densest map of the bank-technology vendor layer; mine once, refresh periodically.
Archived legacy MASIT member list; one-off diff against the current roster to catch vendor entries/exits.
FIC publishes the annual White Book plus member catalogue and releases where foreign-owned banks state policy positions on record.
AmCham issues recurring position papers and committee output with bank members; standalone monitorable channel.
Parsable annual member-directory PDF of the largest bilateral association; mine for leads then archive.
Fintech/non-bank lender association is squarely in payments scope, but DNS/liveness unproven — recheck in the browser pass.
Treasury/FX practitioner body of some value, but low publication volume and unverified reachability.
Parallel chamber system giving a second member universe to diff against Стопанска комора.
Regional Albanian-language chamber adds a language/member dimension otherwise unrepresented; low ongoing signal.
LinkedIn carries early MBA announcements but is ToS-restricted for scraping; needs a human access/legal decision.
Single aggregator entity record useful for entity resolution, not a producing feed.
Specialist MK banking and payment-cards trade portal; continuous, uniquely local signal on banks and card/POS events.
Government-adjacent registry of recognised chambers; harvest the authoritative chamber list once.
Owner of payment-services law, fiscalisation policy and financial-sector strategy; fetch failure looks like bot filtering only.
MoF archive host preserves pre-redesign strategies and press releases needed for time-series and dead-link resolution.
Debt-report series is a section of finance.gov.mk already monitored; keep as a targeted path, not a separate source.
UJP owns fiscalisation and the e-Faktura mandate — the most commercially relevant state source for POS/fiscal and e-invoicing vendors.
e-Faktura spec/document directory sets the technical standard MK POS and ERP vendors must implement; directory listing may need browser access.
Official statistical releases including ICT usage and financial-sector structural data — steady in-scope publisher.
PX-Web machine-readable API is the cheapest structured feed for MK macro and sector time series.
Second SSO domain may only duplicate stat.gov.mk; confirm whether it carries unique content before registering.
Deposit guarantee scheme; annual reports and payout announcements are the primary signal on failing banks and savings houses.
FIU annual reports break STRs down by reporting-entity type including payment institutions and remitters — rare payments-risk window.
State audit reports expose IT-system and payment/fiscal procurement failings at state financial bodies found nowhere else.
